items.name: All countries
items.description: Every flag, with no regions to lean on.

items.name: Europe
items.description: Tricolour after tricolour — telling them apart is the whole job.

items.name: Africa
items.description: Green, yellow and red almost everywhere. The difference is in the details.

items.name: Americas
items.description: Both Americas at once: stars, stripes and a lot of blue.

items.name: Asia
items.description: Crescents, discs and dragons — no two alike.

items.name: Oceania
items.description: The Southern Cross, and a Union Jack in the corner of most of them.
